comments.author: yuri
comments.text:
Completed from resume (session had provider connection errors).

FILES (commit c396b63):
- lib/adapters/omp_agent.ts — added args option (prepended before --mode flag) so a child can be driven via /bin/sh -c instead of a freshly written script file
- lib/adapters/omp_agent.test.ts (was untracked, now committed) — fixed the send/kill stdin test
- lib/adapters/unix_socket.test.ts — fixed latent bug: rawConversation called done (the Promise) instead of its resolver; unused socket param
- lib/adapters/jsonl_store.test.ts — aligned with upstream LogEntry types (t: number, RawOmpEvent kind vocab): prompt→user_message, message→assistant_message, tool→tool_call, system→session_start; assertions updated to match

ENOENT ROOT CAUSE (verified by isolation, not guessed):
The test spawned a freshly written wrapper script (sink.sh in /var/folders temp). On macOS, exec of a newly-created script file goes through Gatekeeper/syspolicy assessment, which can silently block/delay it — the child process never exec'd (confirmed via a child-side trace: zero executions), so cat never created stdin-echo.jsonl and the later Bun.file(...).text() got ENOENT. SIGTERM arriving during the (blocked) exec kills the child pre-exec with no visible error. System binaries like /bin/sh and /bin/cat are not assessed, so spawning /bin/sh -c works. Second race fixed in same test: SIGTERM could arrive after exec but before cat read stdin, truncating the sink; now the test polls for the expected sink content (deterministic readiness signal) before kill. No sleeps.

VERIFY: bun test lib/ → 144 pass / 0 fail (8 consecutive runs stable); bunx tsc --noEmit → clean.

STORE SEMANTICS FOR COACH RECONCILIATION: I keep tk-uhp's (main, 88b7521) store implementations as canonical — my jsonl_store.test.ts now compiles against THEIR types (numeric t, RawOmpEvent kind vocab) and my json_store.ts/jsonl_store.ts impls are left untouched in this branch for you to reconcile by hand (drop mine, keep tk-uhp's). My remaining unique work is omp_agent (+args fix), unix_socket test fix, and omp_agent.test.ts.
